description: Description About Us Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. Position Overview The EUC Engineer is responsible for engineering, securing, automating, supporting, and continuously improving enterprise end-user computing platforms and services. The role focuses primarily on the management of Windows endpoints, Microsoft Intune, endpoint applications, operating-system lifecycle, security and compliance controls, device provisioning, endpoint monitoring, vulnerability remediation, and user-experience improvements. The EUC Engineer works across the full endpoint lifecycle—from engineering standards and solution design through testing, deployment, monitoring, remediation, production support, and retirement. The engineer is expected to move beyond individual break/fix activities by developing repeatable, scalable, secure, and automated solutions that improve endpoint reliability, employee experience, operational efficiency, security posture, and supportability. The role partners closely with Service Desk, Desktop Support, Security, Identity, Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Application, Compliance, and business teams to ensure end-user technology services remain secure, stable, standardized, and aligned with organizational requirements. Role: EUC Engineer Key Responsibilities Manage and support Windows endpoints using Microsoft Intune and related Microsoft technologies. Develop and maintain device configuration profiles, compliance policies, security baselines, and endpoint standards. Support Windows 11 upgrades, device provisioning, imaging, Autopilot, and endpoint lifecycle activities. Package, test, deploy, update, and retire enterprise applications using Intune and other endpoint-management tools. Develop PowerShell scripts and automated remediation solutions to reduce manual effort and recurring support issues. Identify and remediate Critical and High-risk endpoint vulnerabilities and unsupported software. Implement and support endpoint security controls including BitLocker, Defender, device restrictions, Conditional Access, and compliance requirements. Support specialized and secure endpoint environments, including controlled or Cleanroom device configurations. Troubleshoot complex Windows, Intune, application, authentication, policy, and endpoint-related issues. Support integration between physical endpoints and Azure Virtual Desktop/WVD environments. Develop endpoint monitoring, reporting, dashboards, and analytics to identify health, compliance, and performance issues. Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions for recurring incidents. Support Service Desk and Desktop Support teams through technical escalation, documentation, knowledge transfer, and engineering guidance. Participate in incident, problem, change, patch, and vulnerability-management processes. Maintain accurate technical documentation, implementation plans, operational procedures, and support runbooks. Continuously identify opportunities for endpoint standardization, automation, self-service, security improvement, and operational efficiency. Technical Skills Preferred experience with: Microsoft Intune Windows 10/11 Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD Windows Autopilot PowerShell Microsoft Defender for Endpoint BitLocker Conditional Access Application packaging and deployment Intune Remediations Endpoint security and compliance Vulnerability and patch management Azure Log Analytics / Endpoint Analytics Azure Virtual Desktop / WVD Microsoft Graph API Git / GitHub or similar source-control tools Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience. Typically 3–6 years of experience in EUC, Endpoint Engineering, Desktop Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related role. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and enterprise Windows endpoint management. Strong troubleshooting, scripting, automation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively across Infrastructure, Security, Service Desk, Desktop Support, and business teams. Key Competencies Endpoint engineering and troubleshooting Automation and continuous improvement Security and compliance awareness Root-cause analysis Technical ownership Cross-functional collaboration Documentation and knowledge sharing Customer and employee experience focus Key Measures of Success Success in the role may be measured through: Endpoint compliance and security posture Reduction in vulnerabilities and unsupported software Application deployment success Windows upgrade and device lifecycle completion Reduction in recurring incidents Increased automation and automated remediation Improved endpoint reliability and user experience Reduction in manual support effort Successful delivery of EUC modernization initiatives Role Expectation The EUC Engineer is expected to move beyond individual device troubleshooting and focus on creating repeatable, secure, automated, and scalable endpoint solutions that improve reliability, security, supportability, and employee experience.
